notes.title: Version 1.15
notes.notes:
Version 1.15
- Pufferfishes were added, and can be unlocked as playable characters by reaching at least Level 30. If you were already at, or past, Level 30 before the update, just play through one match in any mode and win the match to unlock them. Auto-damage on physical contact; useful when you don't have any Energy. Can cause illness to anyone who comes into contact with them, whether opponent or ally. They lose health in land environments. Selecting all Fish/Sea Creature types spawns the underwater stage where they don't lose health.
- Cold-Blooded animals move even slower in cold temperatures, and even faster in hot temperatures, within limits. Their movement speed gets set to a fixed number in both cases, so all of them will move at the same speed in the same temperatures, regardless of skill level number and base stats. 
- Omni-Species can change its attack type again. In a previous version, it stopped switching types as it was intended to, possibly due to a change in the attack and targeting system.    
- Items are no longer gained upon winning, but Currency and Experience can still be gained. Currency can still be used to buy items, as well.
- Desktop icon is larger.

--------------

Other details from previous versions that weren't reflected on the desktop version until this update:

Version 1.11
- Misquito has a fully animated travel animation.

Version 1.10
- Flying uses Energy steadily as long as you're above the ground. Selecting to fly lower or higher is noted in the Battle Log, and resumes the game when selecting it from a menu. If there is no more Energy, the character will drop to the ground-level. 
- Missed and blocked attacks are now indicated where damage is shown at, instead of the Battle Log.
- Credits further extended on title screen for software used to make the game.

notes.title: Version 1.08
notes.notes:
- Spiders added. Spiders can use multiple items at once since they have the "Extra Appendages" Feature. They use their "Web" attack which can cause the Immobilized status to any opponent or ally. Does not affect other spiders.
- Stages added (three): one cave-themed, one dawn-themed, and a grass field-themed stage.
- Item usage now has a graphical effect.
- Projectile damage was made more accurate (it was previously counting damage more than once per frame).
- Full-Screen (borderless) is now available, and is displayed by default.

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
- Switching between available A.I. Group members has been implemented. Items can only be used by non-defeated members as a result.
- Two items can be used at once if your creature has the "Extra Appendages" Feature.
- Water-themed stage added that spawns when all Crabs are chosen.
- Statuses were given visual indicators.
- Controller buttons can be customized.
- Abilities have been added and can be accessed from the menu. Certain Features that come with a creature will grant the use of these Abilities. An example is Flying, which allows you to adjust the flying height of the player.
- Item added, Trickster's Bag, which gives a chance to put a random status effect on an opponent.
- A.I. opponents can now use items. Their item usage will be displayed in the Battle Log.
- Crabs have been made directly playable. Their attacks were also made stronger.
- Selector icon changed for more precision with selections.
- Incremental damage and restoration to health has been adjusted across many statuses and effects to make them more apparent.
- Emotions will be applied if the Difficulty is set to Hard. Characters will randomly spawn under different emotional statuses.
- "Heal" move from Mages can now heal more based on their skill level, and can cover a wider area.
- Flight and gravity glitches fixed so that anyone flying can consistently fly during each match. Also, this allows anyone who goes up high enough to avoid appearing to be attacked while high up enough (issue was with the system's info on character's actual air placement number, and where they appeared to be on-screen were delayed from one another).
- Info menu was updated.
- Stage with full moon and rocky terrain had slightly more stars added in the sky.
- Perspective in multiplayer was adjusted so that the viewpoint is closer.
- Battle Log auto-scrolling slightly slowed down to allow more time to read. A full view of the Battle Log can also be viewed in the Info menu.

notes.title: Multiplayer
notes.notes:
Version 1.05
- Multiplayer Mode for offline gameplay added.
- Movement speed increased for player-controlled characters.
- Auto Difficulty setting put in for applicable modes to automatically set CPU opponent levels similar to the player's level. Other difficulty settings still remain.
- Depth displayed adjusted, particularly for damage indicator.
- Text for Mage's "Heal" move was changed to more accurately explain that Group members had to be nearby. 
- Error fixed with duplicate text displaying on Cure-All item.

notes.title: Controller Support
notes.notes:
Version 1.04

- Compatible with a PS4 controller, and Joy-Con. Allows interaction with characters, gameplay, and menus.
- Attack Energy error fixed where pressing a certain button while attacking would cause it to excessively drain.
- Menus and some prompts/indicators were slightly changed for some options to help accommodate for the controller update. Controls were updated in the menu.

notes.title: Omni-Species Is Now Playable
notes.notes:
Version 1.02

- Omni-Species is now playable after defeating him in Arcade Mode.
- A.I. characters can now go after their target moving forward and backward. Previously, it was just from side to side for CPU characters.
- Attack ranges were increased to be able to hit from farther away.
- Menus were made easier to navigate.
- Reptile health regeneration was increased to be more noticeable.
- Statuses of Illness and Injury had damage increased to compensate for the Reptile regeneration increase.
- Merchant area can be accessed after Quick Battle matches.

--------

Previous Update Included:

Version 1.01

- Stage added.
- Music for snow stage was changed.
- In-game Currency earned can now be used in the Merchant area before the last boss of Arcade mode.
